bio: After graduating from Ankara University Faculty of Medicine, Murat Vural practiced as a physician for several years and then took on senior management and training roles at an international level in the pharmaceutical sector. He was responsible for the coordination and operational efficiency of teams composed of various nationalities in different regions.
